title: rhamnus pumila var. rupestris
intro: Rhamnus pumila var. rupestris, commonly known as the Alpine buckthorn or Rock buckthorn, is a shrub plant belonging to the Rhamnaceae family. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress, alleviate pain and inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus pumila var. rupestris include being used as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic agent, as well as having a potential role in cancer prevention due to its antioxidant and pro-apoptotic activities. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, such as vitexin, isovitexin, and rutin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
